CLO1.text: Identify some of the basic approaches to formulating a marketing strategy in order to participate effectively when working with marketing policy coordinators.

CLO2.text: Use an understanding of marketing and the market driven enterprise to differentiate market.

CLO3.text: Identify key stages of the market planning process in order to create marketing plans through development of key sections common to most plans.
